close_reason: handle_task_copy signature widened to accept call_id: &str (matches canonical jmap-mail-server handle_email_copy and jmap-calendars-server handle_calendar_event_copy). onSuccessDestroyOriginal + destroyFromIfInState wired through the per-create loop's copied_source_ids tracker; after the loop, the implicit Task/set response is built and pushed to extra Invocation vec with the triggering callId. stateMismatch on destroyFromIfInState yields an error-shaped synthesized response. Three new tests cover normal emission, stateMismatch path, and absent-flag suppression. Workspace tests 2189 passing.
description: RFC 8620 §5.4: when onSuccessDestroyOriginal is true the server MUST make a single implicit Task/set call against fromAccountId after emitting the Task/copy response. destroyFromIfInState is passed through as ifInState on that implicit call. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server at email.rs:2432-2487 builds the implicit Email/set response and returns it via the extra Vec<Invocation> return-channel. tasks-server handle_task_copy returns vec![] for extra invocations regardless. Fix: after the per-create loop, parse onSuccessDestroyOriginal and destroyFromIfInState; if true and copied_source_ids non-empty, fetch from-account old state, optionally check destroyFromIfInState, call destroy_object::<Task> for each copied source id, build a Task/set response value with destroyed/notDestroyed/oldState/newState/accountId, push it to extras as ("Task/set", value, call_id). Add integration test asserting the synthesized Task/set response appears in methodResponses.
title: tasks-server: Task/copy — onSuccessDestroyOriginal implicit Task/set call (RFC 8620 §5.4)
